args.title: Add S3_ENDPOINT environment variable mention to Running locally setup
args.body:
File: README.md

Add a line in the 'Running locally' steps to mention setting the environment variable S3_ENDPOINT for MinIO usage, since it is required to avoid uploads going to AWS by default. Also consider adding a mention of creating the bucket in the MinIO console for completeness, as per the user's comment.

label: docs
file: README.md
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

This issue requests adding a mention of the S3_ENDPOINT environment variable to the local setup steps in README.md. The variable is documented but not referenced in the setup steps, causing confusion when using MinIO. A pull request is open to add the missing mention and optionally note the need to create the bucket in the MinIO console.
